## Loading Data
```{r}
read_clean <- function(file_path) {
  df <- read.csv(file_path, header = TRUE, na.strings = c("", "NA"), stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
  df[df == "NA"] <- NA  
  return(df)
}

cessationtrain <- read_clean("cessationtrain.csv")
cessationtrain_ohe <- read_clean("cessationtrain_ohe.csv")
cessationtrain_num <- read_clean("cessationtrain_num.csv")
cessationtrain_num_ohe <- read_clean("cessationtrain_num_ohe.csv")

cessationtest <- read_clean("cessationtest.csv")
cessationtest_ohe <- read_clean("cessationtest_ohe.csv")
cessationtest_num <- read_clean("cessationtest_num.csv")
cessationtest_num_ohe <- read_clean("cessationtest_num_ohe.csv")

list(
  train = list(
    dim = dim(cessationtrain),
    missing = sum(is.na(cessationtrain)),
    head = head(cessationtrain)
  ),
  
  test = list(
    dim = dim(cessationtest),
    missing = sum(is.na(cessationtest)),
    head = head(cessationtest)
  )
)
```

convert_factor <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(-ID, as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(factor_vars), as.factor))
}

cessationtest <- convert_factor(cessationtest)

##T-Tests
```{r}
numeric_vars <- setdiff(numeric_vars, "QuA1Rc")

t_results <- lapply(numeric_vars, function(var) {
  df <- data.frame(
    value = cessationtrain_num_ohe[[var]],
    group = as.factor(cessationtrain_num_ohe$QuA1Rc)
  )
  df <- df[!is.na(df$value) & !is.na(df$group), ]
  
  if (length(unique(df$group)) == 2 && all(table(df$group) > 1)) {
    lev <- leveneTest(value ~ group, data = df)
    equal_var <- lev$`Pr(>F)`[1] > 0.05
    
    ttest <- t.test(value ~ group, data = df, var.equal = equal_var)
    
    data.frame(
      variable = var,
      quit_mean = mean(df$value[df$group == levels(df$group)[1]], na.rm = TRUE),
      no_quit_mean = mean(df$value[df$group == levels(df$group)[2]], na.rm = TRUE),
      p_value_ttest = ttest$p.value,
      p_value_levene = lev$`Pr(>F)`[1],
      equal_variance = equal_var
    )
  } else {
    data.frame(
      variable = var,
      quit_mean = NA,
      no_quit_mean = NA,
      p_value_ttest = NA,
      p_value_levene = NA,
      equal_variance = NA
    )
  }
})

t_tests <- do.call(rbind, t_results)
t_tests$p_value_fdr <- p.adjust(t_tests$p_value_ttest, method = "fdr")
t_tests <- t_tests[order(t_tests$p_value_fdr), ]
write.csv(t_tests, "~/Desktop/LV-main/quit_t_tests.csv", row.names = FALSE)

t_tests_p1 <- t_tests[t_tests$p_value_ttest < 0.1, ]
t_tests_p05 <- t_tests[t_tests$p_value_ttest < 0.05, ]

rm(t_results, numeric_vars)
```

##Fisher's Tests
```{r}
fisher_results <- lapply(factor_vars, function(var) {
  df <- data.frame(
    var_value = cessationtrain_num_ohe[[var]],
    group = cessationtrain_num_ohe$QuA1Rc
  ) %>% filter(!is.na(var_value) & !is.na(group))
  
  tbl <- table(df$var_value, df$group)
  
  if (nrow(tbl) > 1 && ncol(tbl) > 1) {
    test <- fisher.test(tbl)
    
    data.frame(
      variable = var,
      p_value_fisher = test$p.value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    data.frame(
      variable = var,
      p_value_fisher = NA_real_
    )
  }
})

fisher_tests <- do.call(rbind, fisher_results)
fisher_tests$p_value_fdr <- p.adjust(fisher_tests$p_value_fisher, method = "fdr")
fisher_tests <- fisher_tests %>% arrange(p_value_fdr)
write.csv(fisher_tests, "~/Desktop/LV-main/quit_fisher_tests.csv", row.names = FALSE)

fisher_tests_p1 <- fisher_tests[fisher_tests$p_value_fisher < 0.1, ]
fisher_tests_p05 <- fisher_tests[fisher_tests$p_value_fisher < 0.05, ]

rm(fisher_results, factor_vars)
```

## Logistic Regression
```{r}
quit <- "QuA1Rc"
cessationtrain_num_ohe[[quit]] <- factor(cessationtrain_num_ohe[[quit]], levels = c(2, 1), labels = c(0, 1))
predictors <- setdiff(names(cessationtrain_num_ohe), c("ID", quit))

log_results <- vector("list", length(predictors))

for (i in seq_along(predictors)) {
  var <- predictors[i]
  
  formula <- as.formula(paste(quit, "~", var))
  
  fit <- tryCatch(glm(formula, data = cessationtrain_num_ohe, family = binomial),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    log_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      variable = var,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      ci_low = NA_real_,
      ci_high = NA_real_
    )
    next
  }
  coef_summary <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  
  if (nrow(coef_summary) < 2) {
    log_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      variable = var,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      ci_low = NA_real_,
      ci_high = NA_real_
    )
    next
  }
  
  p_val <- coef_summary[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  est <- coef(fit)[2]
  se <- coef_summary[2, "Std. Error"]
  
  odds <- exp(est)
  ci95_low <- exp(est - 1.96 * se)
  ci95_high <- exp(est + 1.96 * se)
  
  log_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    variable = var,
    p_value = p_val,
    odds_ratio = odds,
    ci_low = ci95_low,
    ci_high = ci95_high
  )
}

logreg_tests <- do.call(rbind, log_results)
logreg_tests <- logreg_tests[order(logreg_tests$p_value), ]
write.csv(logreg_tests, "~/Desktop/LV-main/quit_logreg_tests.csv", row.names = FALSE)

logreg_tests_p1 <- subset(logreg_tests, p_value < 0.1)
logreg_tests_p05 <- subset(logreg_tests, p_value < 0.05)

rm(log_results)
```

#Variable Lists
```{r}
#p < 0.1 Threshold
ttest_vars_p1 <- t_tests_p1$variable
fisher_vars_p1 <- fisher_tests_p1$variable
t_fisher_vars_p1 <- union(ttest_vars_p1, fisher_vars_p1)
logreg_vars_p1 <- logreg_tests_p1$variable

t_fisher_unique_p1 <- setdiff(t_fisher_vars_p1, logreg_vars_p1)
logreg_unique_p1 <- setdiff(logreg_vars_p1, t_fisher_vars_p1)
sig_vars_p1 <- intersect(t_fisher_vars_p1, logreg_vars_p1)

print(t_fisher_unique_p1)
print(logreg_unique_p1)
print(sig_vars_p1)

keep_vars_p1 <- unique(sub("\\..*", "", sig_vars_p1))

print(keep_vars_p1)

full_vars_p1 <- unique(unlist(lapply(keep_vars_p1, function(root) {
  grep(paste0("^", root, "(\\.|$)"), names(cessationtrain_num_ohe), value = TRUE)
})))

print(full_vars_p1)

#p < 0.05 Threshold
ttest_vars_p05 <- t_tests_p05$variable
fisher_vars_p05 <- fisher_tests_p05$variable
t_fisher_vars_p05 <- union(ttest_vars_p05, fisher_vars_p05)
logreg_vars_p05 <- logreg_tests_p05$variable

t_fisher_unique_p05 <- setdiff(t_fisher_vars_p05, logreg_vars_p05)
logreg_unique_p05 <- setdiff(logreg_vars_p05, t_fisher_vars_p05)
sig_vars_p05 <- intersect(t_fisher_vars_p05, logreg_vars_p05)

print(t_fisher_unique_p05)
print(logreg_unique_p05)
print(sig_vars_p05)

keep_vars_p05 <- unique(sub("\\..*", "", sig_vars_p05))

print(keep_vars_p05)

full_vars_p05 <- unique(unlist(lapply(keep_vars_p05, function(root) {
  grep(paste0("^", root, "(\\.|$)"), names(cessationtrain_num_ohe), value = TRUE)
})))

print(full_vars_p05)
```
